faq.hero_desc: Everything you want to know about M!LK, bamboo, shipping and our products.

questions.q: Why bamboo rather than cotton?
questions.r: Bamboo is naturally thermo-regulating, antibacterial and 3× softer. It absorbs moisture faster than cotton, regulates body temperature and contains fewer allergens. Ideal for a newborn's skin, which is 5× thinner than ours.

questions.q: Is M!LK bamboo certified?
questions.r: Yes. Every M!LK batch is OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified — the most demanding textile certification, testing over 100 harmful substances. Zero compromise.

questions.q: Does bamboo shrink in the wash?
questions.r: Our products are pre-washed. Wash at 30°C, gentle cycle, dry flat. Softness and shape are preserved indefinitely.

questions.q: Is bamboo suitable for babies with eczema?
questions.r: Yes. Bamboo microfibres are round and smooth. Naturally hypoallergenic and antibacterial — recommended for sensitive and atopic skin.

questions.q: Can I machine-wash M!LK clothing?
questions.r: Yes. Machine wash at 30°C, gentle cycle. Avoid fabric softener — it clogs the fibres and reduces bamboo's breathability.

questions.q: What are the delivery times?
questions.r: Orders placed before 4pm: same-day shipping (business days). Colissimo: 2-3 business days (home or pickup point). An email with the tracking number is sent as soon as the order ships.

questions.q: Is delivery free?
questions.r: Yes, free delivery from €60. Below that, shipping fees are shown at checkout.

questions.q: Do you ship outside France?
questions.r: For now, we only ship within mainland France. International shipping is coming soon.

questions.q: Can I track my order?
questions.r: Yes. An email with the Colissimo tracking number is sent as soon as the order ships. Track it on laposte.fr or in your profile area.

questions.q: Can I return an item?
questions.r: Yes, within 14 days of receipt. The item must be unworn and in its original condition. Contact us at contact@milkbebe.fr to start a return. Return shipping is at the customer's expense (Colissimo recommended).

questions.q: How do I cancel an order?
questions.r: Contact us as soon as possible at contact@milkbebe.fr. If the order hasn't shipped yet, we can cancel it. After shipping, a return is the only option.

questions.q: My item is defective — what should I do?
questions.r: Send a photo to contact@milkbebe.fr. We replace or refund immediately, no questions asked. Quality is our core commitment.

questions.q: Can I order without creating an account?
questions.r: For now, an account is required to complete an order. Guest checkout is coming soon.

questions.q: How do I choose the right size?
questions.r: Newborn: up to ~3 kg. 0-3 months: 3 to 6 kg. 3-6 months: 6 to 9 kg. When in doubt, go one size up — bamboo adapts. Size charts are available on every product page.

questions.q: Is M!LK clothing suitable for premature babies?
questions.r: Our sizes start at Newborn (up to 3 kg). For premature babies, contact us — we have advice based on birth weight.

questions.q: How are M!LK products made?
questions.r: Our essentials are designed with care for the details that matter: smart openings, silent closures, flat anti-chafing seams, built-in mittens. Every product solves a real problem for an exhausted parent.

questions.q: Are the patterns available in all sizes?
questions.r: Yes. All our patterns (Lightning, Smileys, Checkerboard) are available in every size, while stocks last. Stock is limited — if it's sold out, you can set a restock alert.

questions.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
questions.r: Card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), Apple Pay, Google Pay. All payments are secured via Stripe — your card details never pass through our servers.

questions.q: Is my data secure?
questions.r: Yes. Stripe payment (PCI-DSS certified), customer data stored on Supabase with encryption at rest. We never sell your data — it is only used to process your order and send your M!LK emails if you've opted in.

questions.q: Can I use a promo code?
questions.r: Yes. The promo code applies at the cart step, before payment. One code per order. Codes have an expiry date shown in the confirmation email.

faq.q: Is bamboo really better than organic cotton for newborns?
faq.r: Yes. Bamboo is naturally thermo-regulating, antibacterial and 3× softer. Organic cotton is pesticide-free but lacks these functional properties — a decisive advantage for a newborn's ultra-sensitive skin.

faq.q: Does bamboo shrink in the wash?
faq.r: Our M!LK products are pre-washed to prevent shrinking. A wash at 30°C max, gentle cycle, keeps the shape and softness indefinitely.
Yes — bamboo grows without pesticides, regenerates naturally within months and uses 30% less water than cotton.
Yes, machine wash at 30°C, gentle cycle. Avoid fabric softener. Drying flat is recommended.

about.title: About us
about.mom_p1: And I still remember those mornings in pyjamas — both of them cuddled against me, warm, smiling, the world still a little blurry. Those moments when nothing else exists.
about.mom_p2: In that everyday life, intense and gentle at once — where everything moves fast, everything is new, and you just look for simple things. A piece you grab without thinking, slip on in two seconds, and that is just… perfect. For them. For us.
about.block_p1: No overload. Nothing superfluous. Essentials with character — modern, unisex, different — for little ones who already deserve something a bit unusual.
about.block_p2: My boys have grown up. And with them, I learned. I learned what I would have loved to find from day one. That's M!LK — years of dreams, glances and longings, finally put into practice.
about.block_p3: We start with 0-6 months. But the vision is far bigger.
about.block_support: Support us — the most beautiful projects are coming.
about.values_sub: Just what matters when you're exhausted.
about.philo_quote_l1: Button-up pyjamas? A guaranteed battle at every change.
about.philo_quote_l2: Separate mittens? They get lost, fall off, disappear right when baby needs them most.
about.philo_p1: Here, every M!LK product solves a real problem. Fewer movements, less struggle, fewer things to manage. The evening routine becomes smooth, not stressful.
about.philo_p2: No pointless features. Just what matters when you're exhausted.

valeurs.titre: Every product solves a real problem.
valeurs.texte: No design for design's sake. No pointless features. We start from a concrete problem — getting dressed turning into a fight, overheating, lost mittens — and look for the simplest solution.
No excessive seasonal collections. We perfect the pieces that really matter: bodysuit, pyjama, sleep bag. The ones you use every day, several times a day.
Every product starts with a question: is this fabric really better for baby's skin? Bamboo isn't a trend. It's the most functional answer we found.

valeurs.titre: Made by parents, for exhausted parents.
valeurs.texte: We've lived the struggles. The bodysuits that don't open easily at 3am. The overheating. The irritation. The 15 snaps to line up while baby wriggles. We fixed them.
